negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, 3D CGI plastic skin, glossy CGI render, flat 2D digital drawing, vector art, cartoon, real human skin, dark gloomy weather, rain, stormy dark clouds, deformed hands, broken saxophone, limp scarf, missing scarf, oversaturated neon magenta
reconstruction_priority: dynamic horizontal wind-blown aerodynamics of the extraordinarily long orange scarf and hair — AI often collapses the scarf into a limp drooping rag or removes it entirely

authentic miniature stop-motion materials (cotton-batting cloud miniatures, knitted wool yarn, crafted brass saxophone) — AI frequently replaces them with smooth CGI volumetric clouds and plastic textures
precise two-handed grip and mouth embouchure playing the miniature brass saxophone — AI tends to mangle finger placements or float the instrument in mid-air
striking complementary color harmony between vivid marigold orange, azure blue sky, and pure white clouds — AI easily loses color purity or introduces muddy brown tints
